mostWorthwhile.text: Clipping the cradle across the two arches was the most worthwhile fitting: it visibly joined the supports and gave the tile a clear place to sit.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were straightforward but somewhat repetitive in the text interface, although they made the underside battery fitting understandable.

surprise.text: The tile was explicitly introduced as invented, so its lifting power was not presented as a real mechanism. The result showed it seated rather than lifting.

arbitrary.text: No fitting felt arbitrary: each followed a clear goal and visible construction. The tile's power is fictional, as stated at the outset.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see the completed construction used, but the strictly directed fittings left little to decide in this chapter. This text trial cannot tell me how the pictures or handling feel, or whether a child would enjoy them.
